SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Share Purchase Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of [●] (the "Signing Date") by and among:

(A) The Company (as defined below) is a [private limited company / corporation] incorporated under the laws of [jurisdiction] under company number [●].

(B) The Sellers are the registered and beneficial owners of all of the issued and outstanding share capital of the Company (the "Shares"), as set forth in Schedule 1 (Seller and Share Details).

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 Definitions. In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following terms shall have the meanings set out below:

"Accounts" means the audited consolidated financial statements of the Company and each Group Company for the financial year ended [●] (the "Accounts Date"), comprising balance sheet, profit and loss account, cash-flow statement, and notes thereto, copies of which are attached as Schedule 3 (Financial Statements).

"Accounts Date" means [●].

"Affiliate" means, in relation to any person, any person that directly or indirectly Controls, is Controlled by, or is under common Control with, such person.

"Agreement" has the meaning given in the preamble.

"Anti-Bribery Laws" means applicable anti-corruption and anti-bribery legislation, including the UK Bribery Act 2010, the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act 1977, and any equivalent applicable legislation.

"Business" means the business of the Group as carried on at the date of this Agreement, being [description of business].

"Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday) on which banks are open for ordinary business in [London / New York / [●]].

"Buyer" has the meaning given in the preamble.

"Buyer's Group" means the Buyer and each of its Affiliates from time to time.

"Claim" means any claim by the Buyer against the Sellers under or in connection with this Agreement (including any Warranty Claim or Tax Claim).

"Closing" means the completion of the sale and purchase of the Shares in accordance with Article IV.

"Closing Date" means the date on which Closing occurs pursuant to Article IV.

"Company" means [COMPANY NAME], a [private limited company] incorporated in [jurisdiction] under number [●], details of which are set out in Schedule 2.

"Conditions" means the conditions to Closing set forth in Article III.

"Data Room" means the virtual data room hosted by [●] under project name "[●]", an index of which is set out in Part [●] of Schedule 5 (Disclosure Schedule).

"Disclosed" means fairly disclosed (with sufficient details to identify the nature and scope of the matter disclosed) in the Disclosure Letter and/or the Data Room; and "Disclosure" shall be construed accordingly.

"Environment" and "Environmental Laws" mean, respectively, the environment (including air, water, land, and living organisms) and all applicable laws, regulations, and binding codes of practice relating thereto.

"Estimated Purchase Price" has the meaning given in Section 2.3.

"Final Purchase Price" has the meaning given in Section 2.4.

"Fundamental Warranties" means the warranties set forth in paragraphs 1 (Capacity and Authority), 2 (Title to Shares), and 3 (Capitalisation) of Schedule 4 (Warranties).

"Government Authority" means any national, supranational, federal, state, provincial, municipal, or local governmental or regulatory authority, agency, instrumentality, court, tribunal, or body.

"Group" means the Company and each Subsidiary of the Company; and "Group Company" means any of them.

"Intellectual Property" means patents, trade marks, service marks, trade names, domain names, rights in designs, copyright (including rights in computer software), database rights, rights in confidential information (including know-how and trade secrets), and all other intellectual property rights, in each case whether registered or unregistered and including applications for registration, and all rights or forms of protection having equivalent or similar effect anywhere in the world.

"Key Employee" means each of the individuals listed in Schedule 10 (Key Employees).

"Leakage" has the meaning given in Section 2.6 (Locked-Box Mechanics) [if applicable].

"Locked-Box Date" means [●] [if applicable].

"Long-Stop Date" means [●] (being [●] months from the Signing Date), or such later date as the Parties may agree in writing.

"Material Adverse Effect" means any event, change, circumstance, occurrence, effect, or state of facts that, individually or in the aggregate, (a) has or is reasonably expected to have a material adverse effect on the business, financial condition, results of operations, or assets of the Group taken as a whole, or (b) prevents or materially impairs the ability of the Sellers to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby; provided, however, that none of the following shall constitute a Material Adverse Effect or shall be taken into account in determining whether a Material Adverse Effect has occurred: (i) general economic, financial market, or geopolitical conditions; (ii) changes in applicable law or IFRS after the Signing Date; (iii) conditions generally affecting the industry in which the Group operates; (iv) any action taken by the Buyer or at the Buyer's written request; or (v) the announcement of this Agreement.

"Retained Group" means the Sellers and each of their respective Affiliates, excluding the Group Companies.

"Seller Warranties" means the warranties given by the Sellers pursuant to Article VI and as set out in Schedule 4.

"Sellers" has the meaning given in the preamble.

"Shares" means all of the issued and outstanding shares in the capital of the Company, as further described in Schedule 1.

"Signing Date" has the meaning given in the preamble.

"Subsidiary" means any company in which the Company holds, directly or indirectly, a majority of the voting share capital or has the right to appoint or remove a majority of the board of directors.

"Tax" or "Taxation" means all forms of taxation, levies, duties, charges, contributions, withholdings, and rates imposed by any Government Authority, together with all related interest, penalties, surcharges, and costs.

(a) References to a "person" include any individual, company, partnership, joint venture, association, trust, or Government Authority.

(c) References to "writing" include email transmission unless otherwise specified.

(d) The singular includes the plural and vice versa; one gender includes all genders.

(e) The headings are for convenience only and shall not affect interpretation.

(f) "Including" and "includes" mean including without limitation.

(g) Where any obligation is undertaken by two or more persons, that obligation shall be deemed to be joint and several unless expressly stated otherwise.

ARTICLE II — PURCHASE AND SALE; PURCHASE PRICE

2.1 Sale and Purchase. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, on the Closing Date each Seller shall sell and transfer to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall purchase and accept from each Seller, such Seller's Shares as set forth opposite such Seller's name in Schedule 1, free and clear of all Encumbrances and together with all rights attached thereto as at the Closing Date (including the right to receive all dividends and distributions declared, made, or paid on or after the Closing Date) (the "Purchase Price").

2.2 Purchase Price. The aggregate consideration payable by the Buyer for the Shares shall be:

(a) an amount equal to [●] ([●]) (the "Base Purchase Price"); [●]

(b) [subject to adjustment pursuant to Section 2.4 (Purchase Price Adjustment)][or, if locked-box: subject to Section 2.6 (Locked-Box)]; plus

(c) [if applicable: any Earn-Out Amount payable pursuant to Section 2.5].

2.3 Estimated Purchase Price. At least [five (5)] Business Days prior to the anticipated Closing Date, the Sellers shall deliver to the Buyer a written statement (the "Closing Statement Estimate") setting forth the Sellers' good-faith estimates of Net Debt and Working Capital as at the Closing Date and the resulting estimated Purchase Price (the "Estimated Purchase Price"). The Estimated Purchase Price shall be paid by the Buyer to the Sellers at Closing in accordance with Section 4.3.

2.4 Purchase Price Adjustment.

(a) Within [sixty (60)] calendar days after the Closing Date, the Buyer shall prepare and deliver to the Sellers the Completion Accounts and a written statement (the "Final Closing Statement") setting forth the Buyer's calculation of Net Debt, Working Capital, and the resulting Final Purchase Price.

(b) The Sellers shall have [thirty (30)] calendar days after receipt of the Final Closing Statement (the "Review Period") to review it and notify the Buyer of any objections in a written notice (an "Objection Notice") specifying in reasonable detail the items disputed and the basis therefor.

(c) If no Objection Notice is delivered within the Review Period, the Final Closing Statement shall be deemed final and binding on the Parties.

(d) If an Objection Notice is timely delivered, the Parties shall negotiate in good faith for [fifteen (15)] Business Days to resolve the disputed items. If resolution is not achieved, either Party may refer the disputed items to [an independent firm of chartered accountants to be agreed upon by the Parties, or if not agreed within [five (5)] Business Days, appointed by the President of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales] (the "Independent Accountant"), whose determination shall be final and binding, acting as an expert and not an arbitrator. The fees of the Independent Accountant shall be borne [50/50] or as the Independent Accountant directs.

(e) Upon finalisation of the Final Purchase Price:

(i) if the Final Purchase Price exceeds the Estimated Purchase Price, the Buyer shall pay the difference to the Sellers within [five (5)] Business Days; and

(ii) if the Estimated Purchase Price exceeds the Final Purchase Price, the Sellers shall pay the difference to the Buyer within [five (5)] Business Days.

(f) All adjustment payments shall be made with interest at [●]% per annum from the Closing Date to the date of payment.

2.5 Earn-Out [if applicable].

(a) In addition to the Base Purchase Price, the Buyer shall pay to the Sellers an earn-out amount (the "Earn-Out Amount") equal to [●], calculated by reference to [EBITDA / Revenue / other metric] of the Group for the period from [●] to [●] (the "Earn-Out Period"), as determined in accordance with this Section 2.5.

(b) [Earn-Out mechanics, targets, and calculation methodology to be inserted.]

(c) During the Earn-Out Period, the Buyer shall [not take actions designed to artificially reduce Earn-Out / operate the Business in the ordinary course / maintain separate accounting records].

(d) The Sellers' sole representative for Earn-Out purposes shall be [Seller / [●]] (the "Sellers' Representative").

2.6 Locked-Box Mechanics [if applicable / alternative to Section 2.4].

(a) The Base Purchase Price shall be fixed by reference to the locked-box accounts of the Group as at the Locked-Box Date, and shall not be subject to adjustment for movements in working capital or net debt after the Locked-Box Date, save as provided in Section 2.6(b).

(b) "Leakage" means any of the following occurring between the Locked-Box Date and the Closing Date: (i) any dividend, distribution, or return of capital by any Group Company to any Seller or its Affiliate; (ii) any payment by any Group Company to any Seller or its Affiliate other than in the ordinary course at arm's length; (iii) any waiver, deferral, or forgiveness of any amount owed to any Group Company by any Seller; (iv) any transaction fee, management fee, or advisory fee paid to any Seller; (v) any liability assumed by any Group Company for the benefit of any Seller; or (vi) any Tax arising as a direct result of items (i) through (v).

(c) Each Seller severally undertakes to repay to the Buyer, on a pound-for-pound or dollar-for-dollar basis, any Leakage paid to or for the benefit of such Seller.

(d) "Permitted Leakage" means [salary and emoluments of directors and employees in the ordinary course / items set out in Schedule [●]].

2.7 Allocation of Purchase Price. The Parties shall allocate the Purchase Price among the Shares and any other assets or agreements as set forth in Schedule [●] (Purchase Price Allocation) for Tax purposes. The Parties agree to report the Transaction consistently with such allocation and to cooperate with each other in connection with any Tax authority inquiry regarding such allocation.

2.8 Withholding. The Buyer shall be entitled to deduct and withhold from any amounts payable under this Agreement such amounts as the Buyer is required to deduct and withhold under applicable law. The Buyer shall (a) promptly notify the Sellers of any intention to withhold, (b) use commercially reasonable efforts to minimise any withholding, and (c) promptly remit withheld amounts to the applicable Government Authority and provide the Sellers with evidence thereof.

ARTICLE III — CONDITIONS TO CLOSING

3.1 Mutual Conditions. The respective obligations of each Party to consummate the Transaction are subject to the satisfaction or, if permitted, waiver of each of the following conditions as of the Closing Date:

(a) No Injunction. No Government Authority shall have issued or entered any order, injunction, judgment, or decree (whether temporary, preliminary, or permanent) that prohibits, enjoins, or makes illegal the consummation of the Transaction.

(b) Regulatory Approvals. All Regulatory Approvals listed in Part A of Schedule 6 (Required Consents) shall have been obtained (or any applicable waiting period shall have expired or been terminated) without the imposition of any condition or undertaking that would, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

3.2 Conditions for the Benefit of the Buyer. The obligation of the Buyer to consummate the Transaction is subject to the satisfaction or waiver by the Buyer (in its sole discretion) of each of the following conditions as of the Closing Date:

(a) Accuracy of Seller Warranties. (i) The Fundamental Warranties shall be true and correct in all respects as of the Signing Date and as of the Closing Date (or if made as of a specific date, as of such date); and (ii) all other Seller Warranties shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the Signing Date and as of the Closing Date (or if made as of a specific date, as of such date), except where the failure to be so true and correct would not, individually or in the aggregate, have a Material Adverse Effect.

(b) Performance of Obligations. The Sellers shall have performed and complied with in all material respects all covenants, agreements, and obligations required to be performed by them under this Agreement on or before the Closing Date.

(c) No Material Adverse Effect. Since the Signing Date, no Material Adverse Effect shall have occurred and be continuing.

(d) Third-Party Consents. Each of the third-party consents listed in Part B of Schedule 6 (Required Consents) shall have been obtained in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Buyer.

(e) Key Employee Retention. Each Key Employee listed in Schedule 10 (Key Employees) shall either (i) remain employed by a Group Company and not have given or received notice of termination, or (ii) have entered into a written employment agreement with the Buyer (or a Group Company) in form and substance satisfactory to the Buyer.

(f) Closing Deliverables. The Sellers shall have delivered or be ready to deliver to the Buyer all items required to be delivered by the Sellers pursuant to Section 4.2.

3.3 Conditions for the Benefit of the Sellers. The obligation of the Sellers to consummate the Transaction is subject to the satisfaction or waiver by the Sellers (in their sole discretion, acting jointly) of each of the following conditions as of the Closing Date:

(a) Accuracy of Buyer Representations. The representations and warranties of the Buyer set forth in Article VII shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the Signing Date and as of the Closing Date.

(b) Performance of Buyer Obligations. The Buyer shall have performed and complied with in all material respects all covenants, agreements, and obligations required to be performed by it under this Agreement on or before the Closing Date.

(c) Closing Deliverables. The Buyer shall have delivered or be ready to deliver to the Sellers all items required to be delivered by the Buyer pursuant to Section 4.3.

3.4 Efforts to Satisfy Conditions.

(a) Each Party shall use its commercially reasonable efforts to cause the Conditions for which it is responsible to be satisfied as promptly as practicable and in any event before the Long-Stop Date.

(b) The Buyer shall use its best efforts to obtain all Regulatory Approvals, including preparing and filing all necessary notifications within [twenty (20)] Business Days of the Signing Date, responding promptly to requests for information, and making all commitments or undertakings required by any Government Authority, provided that the Buyer shall not be required to agree to any condition that would have a material adverse effect on the Buyer's Group.

3.5 Waiver of Conditions. Either Party may, in its sole discretion and to the extent permitted by law, waive any Condition that is for its sole benefit by written notice to the other Party; provided that the mutual Conditions in Section 3.1 may only be waived by the written agreement of all Parties.

3.6 Termination if Conditions Not Satisfied.

(a) If any Condition (other than those in Section 3.1(b)) has not been satisfied or waived by [●] (the "Initial Long-Stop Date"), the Long-Stop Date may be extended at the option of the Buyer (by written notice to the Sellers) to [●] for the purposes of obtaining Regulatory Approvals only.

(b) If any Condition has not been satisfied or waived by the Long-Stop Date, any Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other Parties; provided that the right to terminate is not available to any Party whose material breach of this Agreement has been the principal cause of the failure of the Condition to be satisfied.

(c) Termination pursuant to this Section 3.6 shall be without prejudice to any accrued rights or obligations of the Parties as at the date of termination.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE IV — CLOSING

4.1 Time and Place of Closing. Subject to the satisfaction or waiver of all Conditions, Closing shall take place at [●] (or at such other place as the Parties may agree) on:

(a) the date that is [five (5)] Business Days after all Conditions have been satisfied or waived; or

(b) such other date and time as the Parties may agree in writing,

such date being the "Closing Date." Closing shall be deemed to have occurred simultaneously, and no element of Closing shall be deemed completed unless all elements have been completed.

4.2 Sellers' Closing Deliverables. At Closing, the Sellers shall deliver or cause to be delivered to the Buyer:

(a) duly executed share transfer form(s) in respect of all of the Shares, transferring the Shares to the Buyer (or its nominee) free and clear of all Encumbrances;

(b) the share certificate(s) representing all of the Shares (or an indemnity for lost certificates in a form acceptable to the Buyer);

(c) written resignations of each director and the secretary of each Group Company designated by the Buyer (in agreed form), taking effect at Closing, with acknowledgement that the individual has no claims against any Group Company;

(d) a duly executed power of attorney in favour of the Buyer (in agreed form) authorising the Buyer to act as the Sellers' attorney in relation to the Shares pending registration;

(e) original statutory books, registers, minute books, certificates of incorporation (and any certificates of name change), and the common seal (if any) of each Group Company;

(f) the Closing Statement Estimate (if not already delivered);

(g) a duly executed Disclosure Letter;

(h) evidence of release of all Encumbrances over the Shares or assets of any Group Company (other than Permitted Encumbrances), in a form satisfactory to the Buyer;

(i) evidence that each third-party consent listed in Part B of Schedule 6 has been obtained;

(j) duly executed board resolutions of each Group Company approving the Transaction, registering the transfer of Shares, and making such other decisions as may be required;

(k) a duly executed Tax Covenant (if not incorporated in this Agreement);

(l) [if applicable] duly executed employment/retention agreements with Key Employees;

(m) [if applicable] the agreed form transitional services agreement;

(n) [if applicable] the agreed form non-compete and non-solicitation agreements with each Seller; and

(o) all other documents, instruments, and agreements required by applicable law or as may be reasonably requested by the Buyer in writing at least [three (3)] Business Days prior to the Closing Date.

4.3 Buyer's Closing Deliverables. At Closing, the Buyer shall:

(a) pay the Estimated Purchase Price to the Sellers (in the proportions set forth in Schedule 1) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the bank account(s) notified by the Sellers in writing at least [three (3)] Business Days before the Closing Date; and

(b) deliver duly executed board resolutions of the Buyer approving the Transaction and the execution of this Agreement and all ancillary documents.

4.4 Registration. The Buyer shall, as soon as practicable after Closing and in any event within [ten (10)] Business Days, take all steps necessary to register the transfer of the Shares in the register of members of the Company and each relevant Group Company.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE V — PRE-CLOSING COVENANTS

5.1 Conduct of Business. From the Signing Date until the earlier of the Closing Date or the termination of this Agreement, except (i) as required by law, (ii) as expressly permitted or required by this Agreement, or (iii) with the prior written consent of the Buyer (not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed), each Seller shall cause each Group Company to:

(a) conduct its business in the ordinary course consistent with past practice;

(b) use commercially reasonable efforts to preserve intact its business organisation, maintain its material assets and properties in good repair, and maintain its existing relationships with customers, suppliers, employees, regulators, and other material third parties;

(c) maintain all material Permits in full force and effect;

(d) comply in all material respects with applicable laws; and

(e) maintain insurance coverage comparable to current coverage.

5.2 Negative Covenants. From the Signing Date until the Closing Date, except as expressly permitted by this Agreement or with the prior written consent of the Buyer, the Sellers shall cause each Group Company not to:

(a) amend its constitutional documents;

(b) issue, allot, grant, or agree to issue, allot, or grant any shares, options, warrants, or other securities or convertible instruments;

(c) acquire or agree to acquire (by merger, acquisition, or otherwise) any shares in, or substantially all assets of, any business or entity with a consideration in excess of [●];

(d) dispose of, or grant any Encumbrance over, any assets outside the ordinary course of business or with a value in excess of [●];

(e) incur any financial indebtedness in excess of [●] in aggregate (other than under existing facilities);

(f) make any capital expenditure commitment in excess of [●] individually or [●] in aggregate;

(g) enter into, materially amend, or terminate any material contract outside the ordinary course of business;

(h) initiate or settle any material litigation, arbitration, or regulatory proceedings;

(i) make any material change to its accounting policies or practices;

(j) change its Tax elections, Tax accounting methods, or file any amended Tax returns in a manner that could adversely affect the Group after Closing;

(k) declare or pay any dividend or distribution, except for Permitted Leakage;

(l) appoint or dismiss any director, officer, or Key Employee, or materially change the terms of employment of any Key Employee;

(m) take any action that would, or would reasonably be expected to, result in any Condition not being satisfied; or

(n) agree or commit to do any of the foregoing.

5.3 Access to Information. Between the Signing Date and the Closing Date, the Sellers shall, subject to applicable law, afford the Buyer and its representatives reasonable access during normal business hours, upon reasonable prior notice, to the books, records, properties, and personnel of the Group, and shall furnish to the Buyer such information as the Buyer may reasonably request; provided that such access shall not unreasonably disrupt the operations of the Group.

5.4 Notification of Changes. Each Seller shall promptly (and in any event within [three (3)] Business Days) notify the Buyer in writing if: (a) it becomes aware that any Condition has not been or is unlikely to be satisfied; (b) any warranty becomes or is likely to become materially untrue; or (c) any material adverse development occurs with respect to the Business.

5.5 No-Shop. From the Signing Date until the Closing Date or earlier termination of this Agreement, the Sellers shall not, and shall cause each Group Company and their respective representatives not to, directly or indirectly: (a) solicit, initiate, or knowingly facilitate any inquiry, proposal, or offer with respect to any acquisition of shares in, or substantially all assets of, any Group Company (a "Competing Proposal"); (b) participate in any discussions or negotiations regarding any Competing Proposal; or (c) enter into any agreement regarding any Competing Proposal.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE VI — SELLERS' WARRANTIES

6.1 Sellers' Warranties. Each Seller (as to itself and, where applicable, as to the Company and each Group Company) represents and warrants to the Buyer as of the Signing Date and as of the Closing Date (except to the extent that any Warranty is stated to be given only as of a specific date) as set forth in Schedule 4 (Warranties).

6.2 Disclosure. The Seller Warranties (other than the Fundamental Warranties) are given subject to and qualified by matters that are Disclosed.

6.3 Warranty Insurance. [If W&I Insurance is in place:] The Buyer has obtained the W&I Insurance Policy. The Parties acknowledge that the Buyer's primary recourse for General Warranty Claims (other than Fundamental Warranty Claims and Tax Claims) shall be first against the W&I Insurance Policy; provided that the Buyer shall not be required to pursue insurance proceeds before making a Claim against the Sellers and shall not be prejudiced in exercising its rights hereunder.

6.4 Several Liability. Each Seller's liability for Warranty Claims and other Claims hereunder shall be several (and not joint), limited to the proportion corresponding to each such Seller's proportion of the aggregate Shares sold hereunder.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE VII — BUYER'S REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

7.1 Buyer's Representations and Warranties. The Buyer represents and warrants to the Sellers as of the Signing Date and as of the Closing Date as follows:

(a) Organisation. The Buyer is duly incorporated, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of [jurisdiction].

(b) Authority. The Buyer has full power and authority to execute, deliver, and perform its obligations under this Agreement and to consummate the Transaction. This Agreement constitutes a legal, valid, and binding obligation of the Buyer enforceable in accordance with its terms.

(c) No Conflict. The execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement by the Buyer do not and will not conflict with or violate (i) its constitutional documents; (ii) any applicable law; or (iii) any material agreement or instrument to which the Buyer is a party.

(d) No Insolvency. The Buyer is not subject to any insolvency, bankruptcy, administration, receivership, winding-up, or similar proceeding.

(e) Financing. The Buyer has available to it, or has received firm written commitments from reputable financial institutions to provide, sufficient funds to pay the Purchase Price and to fulfil all of its obligations under this Agreement.

(f) No Broker. No broker, finder, or investment banker is entitled to any fee or commission from the Buyer in connection with the Transaction.

(g) Investment Purpose. The Buyer is purchasing the Shares for its own account for investment purposes and not with a view to resale or distribution in violation of applicable securities laws.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ARTICLE VIII — INDEMNIFICATION

8.1 Indemnification by Sellers. Subject to the limitations in Schedule 4 (Warranties) and Schedule [●] (Limitations on Claims), each Seller shall, severally (and not jointly), indemnify and hold harmless the Buyer and its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents (collectively, "Buyer Indemnitees") from and against any and all losses, damages, claims, costs, penalties, fines, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) ("Losses") arising out of or resulting from:

(a) any breach of any Fundamental Warranty made by such Seller;

SCHEDULE 7 — COMPLETION ACCOUNTS MECHANICS

1. Preparation of Completion Accounts.

1.1 The Completion Accounts shall be prepared as at close of business on the Closing Date.

1.2 The Completion Accounts shall be prepared in accordance with: (a) IFRS (or applicable local GAAP), consistently applied and using the same accounting policies, principles, practices, and methodologies used in preparing the Accounts; (b) to the extent not covered by (a), the specific accounting policies set out in Annex 1 to this Schedule 7.

1.3 In the event of any conflict between (a) and (b) in paragraph 1.2, the specific accounting policies in Annex 1 shall prevail.

2. Definitions for Completion Accounts Purposes.

2.1 "Cash and Cash Equivalents" means unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Group held in the ordinary course of business as at the Closing Date, excluding any restricted cash, cash subject to Encumbrances, or cash in respect of third-party deposits or security amounts.

2.2 "Financial Indebtedness" means, without double-counting: (a) borrowings under any bank facility, overdraft, or credit facility; (b) outstanding principal on bonds, debentures, or notes; (c) capital lease liabilities (as defined under IFRS 16); (d) deferred consideration for acquisitions; (e) accrued and unpaid interest; (f) break costs, penalties, or fees payable on repayment of Financial Indebtedness; (g) outstanding balances on any vendor or seller notes; and (h) any other items agreed by the Parties to be included.

2.3 "Net Debt" means Financial Indebtedness less Cash and Cash Equivalents.

2.4 "Working Capital" means current assets (excluding cash and cash equivalents) less current liabilities (excluding Financial Indebtedness), in each case as at the Closing Date, calculated in accordance with the items and methodology set out in Annex 2 to this Schedule 7.

SCHEDULE 8 — TAX COVENANT

1. Covenant to Pay. Subject to the limitations in this Schedule 8 and Schedule 4A, the Sellers shall pay to the Buyer an amount equal to any:

  (a) Tax liability of any Group Company arising from any event, transaction, or omission occurring on or before the Closing Date ("Pre-Closing Tax Liability");

  (b) Secondary Tax liability of any Group Company arising from or by reason of any failure by any other person (other than another Group Company) to pay Tax;

  (c) Tax resulting from the failure of any relief, allowance, credit, or exemption assumed in the Accounts ("Accounts Relief") to be available; and

  (d) Costs and expenses incurred by any Group Company or the Buyer in connection with a Sellers' Pre-Closing Tax Liability (including reasonable professional fees),

  in each case net of any corresponding Tax benefit or tax credit actually received by any Group Company.

2. Exclusions. The Tax Covenant shall not apply to any Tax liability:

  (a) for which provision (whether as a specific provision or as part of a general reserve) was made in the Accounts;

  (b) arising from any transaction, act, or omission carried out by the Buyer or any Group Company after Closing otherwise than in the ordinary course of business;

  (c) arising as a result of any change in law, regulation, or Tax rate after the Signing Date;

  (d) that would not have arisen but for a voluntary disclosure made by the Buyer or any Group Company after Closing to any Tax authority;

  (e) subject to the limitations in Schedule 4A; or

  (f) to the extent recovered by the Buyer under the Tax Warranties.

3. Tax Filing and Conduct.

  3.1 The provisions of Article IX (Tax) of the main body of this Agreement shall apply to the conduct of Tax filings.

  3.2 The Sellers shall have conduct of all Tax claims, disputes, or proceedings relating to Pre-Closing Tax Periods, subject to the Buyer's right to be kept reasonably informed and to make representations, and provided that the Sellers shall not settle any such matter without the prior written consent of the Buyer (not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed).

4. Over-Provision and Recoveries. If, following any payment under this Tax Covenant, any Group Company receives a Tax repayment, credit, or relief that is specifically referable to such payment, the Buyer shall promptly account to the Sellers for the amount of such repayment, credit, or relief.

5. Time Limits. The provisions of Schedule 4A, paragraph 1 (Time Limits) shall apply to Tax Claims under this Tax Covenant.
